rules.applies_when: an asset crosses a trust boundary
acceptance: every external entry and protected asset is covered
high residual risk has explicit responsible acceptance
rules.failure_policy: block security approval for uncovered high risk

rules.applies_when: data or commands cross a trust boundary
actions: authenticate and authorize before privileged action
validate canonical format length range and freshness
acceptance: unauthenticated unauthorized replayed oversized and malformed requests are rejected
failure cannot invoke partial privileged side effect
rules.failure_policy: default deny and preserve bounded diagnostic

rules.applies_when: sensitive credential is created stored or used
acceptance: no production secret is hardcoded committed or logged
private material is accessible only to required principal
rules.failure_policy: stop release and treat exposure according to incident process

rules.applies_when: failure can cause unsafe physical behavior
actions: analyze reset disconnect stuck and corrupt input
separate candidate test and approval levels
acceptance: each identified single fault reaches/maintains defined safe state within project limit
network/cloud is not required for local safety
rules.failure_policy: stop physical/release action and continue isolated analysis only

actions: scan debug/test credentials and known vulnerabilities
rules.failure_policy: retain RC status and do not publish

rules.applies_when: deployed product is changed or diagnosed
acceptance: failure cannot silently remain partially applied
rules.failure_policy: isolate target restore last verified state and report
